note: Flat faces of the Nezu square lei, from the project owner's photo-37 (front, near head-on, ≈ 3.5 px/mm on the belly). Points are [photo px, vessel mm x, y, z]: each register's corners and centre, projected through a camera solved on 14 measured landmarks (.work/r7-lei/solve/gen_faces.py: az −0.6°, el 12.1°, roll −0.9°, f 13031 px at 3650 mm — a long lens) and shifted to the photographed centre line. The curved belly and shoulder are flattened PER REGISTER onto each register's chord plane. Round 10b: plan ratio depth : width changed 0.75 → 0.65 (photo-36 refit, dossier §e): every z in this file (centres, points) scaled by 0.65/0.75 and the slanted planes re-tilted; heights kept, images re-rectified.

face-shoulder.label: front (+Z), shoulder frieze y 263–325 — chord plane

face-main.label: front (+Z), belly main mask register y 178–263
face-main.trust: good: a nearly vertical register seen almost head-on (≈ 3.5 px/mm); points from the solved camera (residual ≈ 2–5 mm at the flanged corners).

face-second.label: front (+Z), belly second register y 101–178 — chord plane
face-second.trust: fair-good: the wall leans ≈ 15° (chord plane), seen head-on; the outer columns run behind the corner flanges.

face-low.trust: fair: the wall leans ≈ 18° and curls under at the bottom; the lug covers the centre 60 mm.

face-foot.label: front (+Z), foot frieze y 0–21.5
face-foot.trust: fair: a small vertical band, dark, the lug snout and the foot flanges hide parts of it.

face-collar.label: front (+Z), collar frieze y 325–376
face-collar.trust: fair: a flat vertical band in shade under the lid eave (dark, ≈ 3.5 px/mm).
